sloka: हिरण्यस्य सुवर्णस्य नियुतं पुरुषर्षभ ।आदाय गच्छ शत्रुघ्न पर्याप्तधनवाहनः ।। ७.६४.४ ॥
transliteration: hiraṇyasya suvarṇasya niyutaṁ puruṣarṣabha ।ādāya gaccha śatrughna paryāptadhanavāhanaḥ ।। 7.64.4 ॥

translations.english: O Shatrughna, best among men, take a million units of gold and fine gold, and go, equipped with ample wealth and conveyances.
